about: korean-technical-writing rule: 비교 글은 슬래시와 화살표를 부르기 쉽다.

rubric.text: The comparison says that lru_cache never expires entries on its own, while the dict approach can drop entries after a set time.
Outside code blocks and tables, the Korean prose reads naturally: no double passives such as 되어지다, no '~을 가지다' used for 'have', and no stacked '~에 대한' phrases.
